sv.title: 600 kvinnor har mördats på tre månader i Sydafrika
sv.summary: Det pågår landsomfattande protester i Sydafrika mot den senaste tidens våg av kvinnomord. De senaste siffrorna visar att minst 600 kvinnor mördats i landet mellan juli och september i år.

en.title: 600 women have been murdered in three months in South Africa
en.summary: Nationwide protests are under way in South Africa against the recent wave of femicides. The latest figures show that at least 600 women were murdered in the country between July and September this year.
